what_it_does: This chip enables high-speed optical communication for AI data centers. It takes 4 lanes of data, each carrying information at 212.5 billion bits per second using PAM-4 modulation (a method that packs more information into each signal pulse by using 4 voltage levels instead of 2). The chip integrates a laser driver directly on-board to send signals to an optical module, and includes sophisticated signal processing to handle long-distance electrical cables with high signal loss (40dB, meaning the signal weakens dramatically), all while staying within tight power and heat budgets for modern AI accelerators.
